# History stream compatibility fixtures

`rusqlite-history-stream-v0.sqlite3` was generated once with
`rusqlite = 0.32.1` (`bundled`) by a standalone seed program. It contains the
pre-stream-envelope `event_records` schema and two deterministic legacy events.
It is committed as a binary fixture so decode-compat tests never add or execute
rusqlite at test time.

`turso-pre18-compat.sqlite3.base64` and
`turso-pre18-compat.sqlite3-wal.base64` are a main database plus committed
WAL generated by a standalone program pinned to `turso = 0.7.0-pre.18` and
`turso_core = 0.7.0-pre.18`. The database was checkpointed after creating
`pre18_compat`, then the marker row was committed only to the WAL and the
process exited without running destructors. Decoded SHA-256:

- database: `0f77a97721e9279668d4b171198ef4758f75c4eadd867f2a2cba73790f2a8573`
- WAL: `2ba330a2ca9c4c6dad049ae1ef1759c33cffde2ea1e72b3269765c7f7ea64d57`
